_comment: GoRefer WATI template manifest (M5). Three lead-time transactional templates, all UTILITY (first message to a non-opted-in number must be a warm utility notice — doc-08 A4). Submitted to Meta for approval as a parallel workstream; live sending stays behind ENABLE_WATI_SEND until APPROVED. Positional vars use {{n}} with Meta sample values.
